hawkish.title: October core PCE rises 0.3% m/m and 3.3% y/y
hawkish.summary: Persistent core inflation gives policymakers little reason to pause on disinflation grounds.

data.actual: Core PCE +0.3% m/m and +3.3% y/y, headline +0.3% m/m and +3.8% y/y

hawkish.reason: The monthly core PCE pace held steady. BLS reported a third straight 0.3% monthly core CPI gain on November 10 (https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/cpi_11102026.htm). Together the releases point to persistent underlying inflation ahead of December.
hawkish.market_validation: Across the November 10 CPI release, the Kalshi December >25bp leg rose 5pp from a 0.055 mid at 08:00 ET to 0.105 at 09:00 ET (345,470 contracts in the latter candle). On November 25 the 25bp leg held at 0.92/0.93 and the >25bp leg at 0.03/0.04 from 13:25Z through 14:10Z around PCE.

hawkish.title: October FOMC minutes show broad support for further hikes
hawkish.summary: The committee tilt raises the bar for another hold while leaving the timing and size of the next move open.

data.actual: "almost all participants judged ... further action to raise the target range ... would likely be appropriate"
data.previous: 28 Oct statement: hold, with two dissents for +25bp
data.delta_label: Broad support for further tightening if warranted, with some openness to a larger move

hawkish.reason: At the October press conference, Warsh left December open (https://www.federalreserve.gov/mediacenter/files/FOMCpresconf20261028.pdf). Waller would consider 50bp if monthly core CPI held at 0.3% (https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/speech/waller20261110a.htm). Williams said conditions did not call for dramatic action (https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/feds-williams-still-favors-tighter-monetary-policy-but-says-now-is-not-the-time-for-dramatic-action-5033893).
hawkish.market_validation: The Kalshi December >25bp leg rose 1pp from a 0.065 mid at the 14:00 ET November 18 release to 0.075 at 16:00 ET (19,331 and 3,721 contracts in those candles). The 25bp leg eased from 0.92/0.93 to 0.90/0.91.

hawkish.title: October payrolls rise 165,000 as unemployment falls to 4.1%
hawkish.summary: The hiring surprise and upward revisions weaken the case for holding in December on labour-market grounds.

data.delta_label: +100k vs consensus; +84k of upward revisions; unemployment -0.1pp

hawkish.reason: Hiring outpaced expectations and unemployment fell, suggesting less labour-market slack. The November payroll report is scheduled for December 4 and can change that assessment before the meeting.
hawkish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp-Hike leg 0.64/0.65 (mid 0.645) at the 5 Nov close (23:00 ET) -> 0.78/0.79 (mid 0.785) in the 09:00 ET candle on 6 Nov, +14.0pp across the 08:30 ET release on 68,547 contracts; Polymarket's 25bp leg went 0.655 (5 Nov 23:00 ET) -> 0.785 (6 Nov 09:00 ET), and Reuters reported bets rising 'to 78% following the data from 70% earlier'. The print reversed the 5 November sell-off rather than setting a new high: the leg had closed 4 November at 0.79/0.80.

hawkish.title: Q3 GDP revised to 4.3% as October real spending slips
hawkish.summary: Firm private demand supports tightening, while softer monthly consumption tempers the case for a more aggressive move.

data.actual: Real GDP +4.3% SAAR (advance +3.4%), final sales to private domestic purchasers +5.8% (from +4.9%)
data.forecast: n/a (second estimate; revision, not a consensus release)

hawkish.reason: Higher private final sales point to firm domestic demand in Q3. Real consumption edged down in October (https://www.bea.gov/news/2026/personal-income-and-outlays-october-2026), tempering the signal from the earlier period.
hawkish.market_validation: No net repricing on Kalshi: the Dec 25bp leg held 0.92/0.93 across the 13:30Z release (2,105 contracts in the 13:35Z minute) and the >25bp leg stayed 0.03/0.04, so the print confirmed rather than changed the hike price.

hawkish.title: Gov. Macklem: act early on oil pass-through; 2% targets total CPI
hawkish.summary: Governor warned of second-round oil inflation into 2027 and prioritized total CPI over core relief.

data.actual: 'acting early is preferable'; 2% target applies to total CPI; 'second-round effect of the oil shock'
data.previous: Oct 28: 'proceed carefully' on US tariff headwinds

hawkish.reason: Supersedes Macklem's Oct 28 cautious statement while noting ongoing US tariff uncertainty: he argued acting early beats waiting for clarity, stressed core metrics are inputs rather than targets, and warned absorbed energy/transport costs are spilling over into persistent inflation.
hawkish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp-Hike jumped 0.53/0.54 (12:00 ET) to 0.80/0.82 (13:00 ET, +27.5pp on 5,570 contracts) after Macklem's 12:40 ET speech, holding 0.77/0.78 on Nov 25.

hawkish.title: Oct 28 hike to 2.50%; MPR lifts CPI to 3.5%
hawkish.summary: Hike lifted inflation path to ~3.5% year-end and 3% in 2027, keeping tightening bias open.
hawkish.reason: Consolidates the Oct 28 policy release and MPR growth upgrade: higher-for-longer oil and firmer mid-year demand kept 'there could be a need to increase the policy rate further' active.
hawkish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp-Hike fell 0.48->0.34 on release before recovering; implied bias remains live.

hawkish.title: Nov 10 BoC deliberations: pass-through risk rose, hikes open
hawkish.summary: Council warned rising fuel and input costs risk spreading broadly into core inflation.

data.actual: 'the risk that high inflation could persist and become broad-based had increased'

hawkish.reason: Governing Council judged businesses had mostly absorbed higher costs so far, but past experience and surveys pointed to rising pass-through over the next year.

hawkish.title: Oct headline CPI stuck at 3.1% above 1–3% band
hawkish.summary: Gasoline (+30.9% y/y) and grocery gains keep headline inflation above the BoC's 3% cap.
hawkish.reason: Persistent gasoline, natural gas, grocery (+2.0%), and clothing pressures keep headline inflation above the 1-3% control band despite slowing rents.

dovish.title: Q3 SLOS tightens (-6.5 biz / -26.3 mortgage) as GDP stalls
dovish.summary: Lenders tightened credit broadly ahead of October's hike while Aug–Sep GDP tracked ~1.2%.

data.actual: SLOS biz -6.48, mortgage -26.27; Aug GDP 0.0% m/m, Sep advance -0.1% (Q3 ~1.2% ann.)
data.previous: Q2 SLOS biz -1.04, mortgage +0.64; Jul GDP 0.0%

dovish.reason: Consolidates Q3 SLOS tightening and flat Aug / -0.1% Sep GDP tracking (~0.8pp below Oct MPR's 2% Q3 view), reinforcing existing financial restraint before Q3 GDP prints Nov 30.
dovish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp-Hike eased 0.57->0.51 (-6.0pp) across Nov 20 SLOS release (458 contracts).

dovish.title: Oct LFS: -4.7k jobs, unemployment 6.7%, wages slow to 2.2%
dovish.summary: Flat payrolls, higher joblessness (6.7%), and slower wages reinforce labour-slack pause case.
dovish.reason: Third straight weak employment report pushed unemployment to 6.7% and trimmed wage growth to 2.2%, easing domestic wage-inflation pressure.
dovish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp-Hike fell 0.365->0.30 (-6.5c) and Polymarket fell 40.5%->30.2% on Nov 6 release.

dovish.title: Core CPI cools: ex-energy 2.0%, CPI-trim 1.8%
dovish.summary: Core ex-energy cooling to 2.0% shows limited second-round energy pass-through so far.
dovish.reason: Sub-index core gauges remain anchored at or below 2% on softer shelter (1.4%) and cell-plan prices; scored 1 since headline dominates same release and BoC targets total CPI.
dovish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp-Hike eased 0.485->0.465 (-2.0pp) across Nov 16 release.
